input.query: SELECT variant, AVG(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) conv_rate, AVG(margin_60d_eur) avg_margin, AVG(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN margin_60d_eur END) AS margin_converted, AVG(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * COUNT(*) AS conversions, AVG(bonus_cost_eur) AS bonus_per_subject, STDDEV_SAMP(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS conv_sd FROM fct_experiment_users WHERE experiment_id='topup10_2026q1' GROUP BY variant ORDER BY variant
